status: Frozen: fresh fidelity and geometry PASS; official standard still rejects the unchanged source-real continuity channel, not release-qualified
method: Complete-source world-space triangle intersections and scalar plane/island bounds. Original closed parametric plates and folded rails; no source vertex, index, UV, texture or sampled contour arrays enter runtime.

cause.interpretation: The front-hull projection omitted the elevated rear service frame. This is not a reason to raise the entire engine roof.

transverseRails.shape: Three independent crowned closed rail segments, six upper facet planes and a separate sloping underside.

longitudinalRails.shape: Crowned side rails fall forward; independent thin receiving flanges and actual aft support walls retain the open space beneath their spans.

constructionLimits: The central transverse source rail has approximately 0.14 mm longitudinal asymmetry; the independently authored segments share the measured outer crown section.
Thin closed cover walls use original 6 mm stock and a concealed 1.5 mm receiving lap. Secondary perimeter chamfers, seals and small fasteners remain simplified.

Only the narrow folded outboard foot roots continue approximately 15 mm down into the permanent sloping shoulder. Their source crown is retained with a 1.5 mm lap; there is no such continuation beneath the open middle of the web.

Permanent engine pads and a localized sloping receiving shoulder use closed concealed bottoms into existing hull stock. The central shaft relief and the side-housing continuity channel at X1.86/Z-0.20 remain open.
Longitudinal rails use six measured plane envelopes and proper mirrored winding; tiny end-cap relief and secondary attachments are simplified.

verification.strictCpuHighLow: front/rear/full-sweep band and shoe intersections all zero

exactOldDrawVertexPreservation.method: Subtract only all actual new helper draw-index vertices with multiplicity; hash every remaining world vertex at 10 micrometres. No coordinate, material, gear or hull exemption.

continuity.disposition: Actual source opening remains open; no voxel fill or threshold/label waiver.

comparison.authorVisualReview: Fresh complete neutral board directly inspected. Added raised rear frame reads as separate supported rails in articulated rear views; source gaps are retained. Broad bow guard, casting transitions, seals and smaller fixture relief remain simplified; this is not full-model visual acceptance.
